Nothing Compares to Dove Gear’s Ultimate Bird Vest

  • Home
  • 2026
  • August
  • Nothing Compares to Dove Gear’s Ultimate Bird Vest
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:40
Instaread

Rockport, Texas – After a record-setting 2025, Rockport-based Dove Gear is gearing up for another busy season with the 2026 editions of its popular Ultimate Bird Vest. Hunters can now order the vest in Dove Gear’s proprietary camouflage pattern, as well as the Ultimate Upland Vest in a sage-and-orange color combination that meets upland field safety requirements.

Since introducing its first-generation vest in 2019, Dove Gear has built a loyal following among dove hunters by designing a vest that addresses virtually every need in the field—and several features most hunters never realized they wanted until they used one.

The 2026 models continue that tradition with an emphasis on comfort, durability and practical field performance.

The first thing hunters notice is the quality of the construction. Durable materials, breathable mesh and a comfortable strap system make the vest easy to wear throughout long, hot September hunts. Thoughtful design touches separate it from conventional bird vests and belt-style rigs. The shell pouch flaps, for example, can be tucked away when fast action calls for quick reloads, while zippered security pockets behind the shell pouches keep essentials such as phones, keys and wallets secure.

A removable water bottle holder comes standard and accommodates bottles up to 32 ounces, helping hunters—and their dogs—stay hydrated during long days afield. The holder can be mounted on either side of the vest to suit individual preferences, and an optional second holder is available for those who want additional carrying capacity.

Behind the washable game bag is another zippered compartment designed specifically for spent shotgun hulls, making it easy for hunters to pack out their empties and leave the field as clean as they found it.

One of the vest’s most innovative features is its six-point adjustment system, allowing it to fit everyone from youth hunters to adults wearing up to a 3XL. Adjustable shoulder, side and front straps also make it simple to accommodate heavier clothing during late-season hunts without sacrificing comfort or fit.

Dove Gear founder Terry Koehler says customer satisfaction continues to be one of the company’s greatest points of pride. Despite thousands of Ultimate Bird Vests being sold over the past five years, the company has never had one returned under its 100 percent Satisfaction Guarantee.

The Ultimate Bird Vest also offers custom embroidery, making it an ideal choice for corporate dove shoots, hunting lodges, outfitters and organizations looking for personalized field gear. Individual buyers can also add names or initials for a custom touch.

The 2026 Ultimate Bird Vest carries a suggested retail price of $129.95 and includes free shipping within the continental United States.

For more information or to order, visit www.DoveGear.com.
